detail: how to connect to weixin/wechat
If so, which — `cc-wechat` (simplest) or `claude-code-wechat` by LinekForge (richest features)?
text:
Master, there are several community projects that bridge Claude Code to WeChat/Weixin via MCP channels. Here's the landscape:

---

## WeChat ↔ Claude Code: Available Solutions

| Project | Lang | Stars | Key Differentiator |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`cc-wechat`** | Node | ★ Most | Multi-profile, `cc-channel-patch` for grayscale bypass |
| **`claude-code-wechat`** (LinekForge) | Node | ★ High | Heartbeat, memory replay, remote approval via WeChat |
| **`claude-channel-weixin`** (yingwang) | Node | ★ Solid | Multi-bot, full media pipeline (images/voice/video) |
| **`wechat-clawbot`** | Python | ★ Niche | Async-first, Python-native |
| **`claude-weixin-channel`** | Node | ★ Newer | Streaming real-time, tool progress push |

## How It Works

```
WeChat iOS ←→ iLink Bot API ←→ MCP Channel Server ←→ Claude Code
              (long polling)     (stdio transport)
```

All projects use Tencent's **iLink Bot API** — no reverse engineering. Login via QR code scan.

## Quick Install (Recommended: `cc-wechat`)

```bash
# 1. Install
npx cc-wechat@latest install

# 2. Patch if "Channels not available" error
npx cc-channel-patch@latest

# 3. Launch
claude --dangerously-load-development-channels server:wechat-channel
```

## Important Caveats

- ⚠️ **Research preview only** — requires `--dangerously-load-development-channels` flag
- ⚠️ **WeChat iOS only** — ClawBot plugin, currently in grayscale rollout
- ⚠️ **Not E2E encrypted** — messages pass through Tencent servers
- ⚠️ No API Key mode — requires `claude.ai` account login
- ✅ All projects support **whitelist pairing** (only authorized users can interact)

---

Want me to install one of these, Master? If so, which — `cc-wechat` (simplest) or `claude-code-wechat` by LinekForge (richest features)?
